readiness.hed: Fredericksburg holds sunny and mild through Saturday near 60, clouds up Sunday ahead of a soaking rain Sunday night, then clears again behind gusty Monday-morning showers
readiness.insight: No active alerts are in effect for the Fredericksburg area this morning. Today stays sunny near 60 with light southwest wind around 8 mph -- the calmest, driest day of the stretch. Sunday turns partly sunny near 61 before rain moves in after 7 p.m. Sunday night, bringing a 100% chance of precipitation and a quarter to half inch of rainfall with south wind gusting to 26 mph. That rain clears out before 7 a.m. Monday, giving way to a sunny Monday afternoon near 57, though morning wind gusts could reach 29 mph as the front exits. Monday night turns mostly clear and colder, dropping to 29.
actions: Today is the pick of the weekend for outdoor work, travel or errands -- sunny, dry and light wind.
Rain arrives Sunday evening with a flat 100% chance and real rainfall (a quarter to half inch) -- plan Sunday outdoor activity for daytime hours before 7 p.m.
Monday morning wind gusts to 29 mph as the front clears -- secure anything loose before heading out early.
No watches or warnings are posted; this is routine late-autumn frontal passage, not a storm signal.
